name: DokiDoki Massage
summary:
0 customers, and loan repayment is due in 3 months (12 weeks)… That’s when she appears: Nana Tanaka, a busty beautiful girl. “My shoulders are so stiff… Can you help me?” Your encounter with this pure and impressionable girl will change your fate.

Gameplay A simulation game where you deepen your relationship with Nana while managing funds and various stats to run your massage clinic. Repeat the cycle of “Counseling > Massage > Action Selection” and aim to repay your debt within 3 months (12 weeks). Counseling Phase Weekly conversation session with Nana. Your choices affect Nana’s Trust Level and Development Level You can give her presents Massage Phase (Main Gameplay) Monitor parameters like Sleepiness, Alertness, Pleasure, and Fatigue while caring for Nana.

Use conversations, instructions, and items to keep alertness low Make her feel good with your massage Target special states like sleep or climax for higher ratings and rewards Action Selection Phase Choose from actions like: Rest, Part-time Job, Gambling, Shop, Seminar, PINE, Loan Repayment Manage your stamina, funds, and abilities Actions have limited uses – strategic planning is key!
